svg.metadata:
CosmosAI learning illustrations
The original drawings are project-authored Excalidraw scenes. Web copies are exported with @excalidraw/utils 0.1.5, an MIT-licensed build-time dependency. The browser does not load the Excalidraw editor or its JavaScript bundle.
Exported SVGs include font subsets to render without remote font requests: - Virgil, created by Ellinor Rapp, SIL Open Font License 1.1. https://github.com/excalidraw/virgil/blob/main/LICENSE.md - Cascadia Code, Microsoft Corporation, SIL Open Font License 1.1. https://github.com/microsoft/cascadia-code/blob/main/LICENSE
License texts accompany this notice in Excalidraw-MIT.txt, Virgil-OFL.txt and Cascadia-Code-OFL.txt. The fonts' licenses apply to their embedded font data, not to the surrounding project-authored teaching content.

svg.title: Milestone 48: DataLoader feeds real CNN training

g.text: Milestone 48: DataLoader feeds real CNN training
Blue function labels open VS Code. Purple concept labels open Obsidian.
One model + optimizer survive all epochs. Only train data change the weights.
Reads the train split, builds the loader,
and keeps one CNN + SGD optimizer.
Manual batching stays a separate demo.
Lazy records; files load on demand
Kingston adds disk space, not RAM.
M51 Dataset reads files on demand.
create once; iterate again every epoch
Dataset returns one CHW image + label.
Loader stacks items into a batch.
A final smaller batch is kept.
Stacking does not mix the images.
each batch supplies image and label tensors
Clear old gradients before the forward pass.
Current weights turn images into logits.
No weights change during this calculation.
One score per class, per image.
Softmax can turn scores into probabilities.
compare each score row with its known label
and how sensitive loss is to that weight.
Weights have not been updated yet.
not evidence of real galaxy accuracy.
Concept: one step versus a loop
gradients tell SGD how to change weights
Each weight has its own gradient.
Clear old gradients before the next batch;
then compute its new forward pass.
Loss average: count images, not batches
This fixes reporting, not the SGD formula.
Dashed return: next batch; after the last batch, begin the next epoch. Same model.
after ALL epochs, main() evaluates then saves
main() first evaluates the trained model.
Then save weights, load a fresh CNN,
Neither evaluation nor reload trains it.
Read-only checks use the final loop model.
The separate one-step proof is not saved.
M49 now stores preprocessing with weights
so training CLI and API use the same input.
